titulo: One Grain of Rice Broke a Kingdom
descripcion:
Legend says an inventor asked a king for one tiny reward: one grain of rice on the first square of a chessboard, then double it on every square after. The king laughed... until the granaries ran empty.

By square 21 it's a million grains. The last square alone? More rice than the whole world grows in hundreds of years.

That's the power of doubling, and it's exactly how compound interest works. The trick isn't having a lot. It's starting at square one. 💰

(Based on the old chessboard-and-rice legend. General money lesson, not financial advice.)
